evidence.detail: The abstract class defines a whole-model preparation hook plus one per-face transform hook over R30 Model and supplies the default loop across Model.ah face count.
Its only exact-v308 subclasses are ModelRecolorTransform, ModelReshadeTransform and ModelRetextureTransform.
All concrete subclasses operate on Model face/surface arrays and respect the per-face exclusion/processed flag where applicable; no vertex-position or animation behavior is owned here.

evidence.detail: Definition config loaders map exact keys retexture/retextures and textures to rs/a/b/e mapping builders.
The transform stores source face/color ids and one or more int-to-int mapping tables from source ids to destination texture/material ids.

Before per-face application it counts matching faces and allocates/initializes Model texture-related arrays; matching faces are marked processed, Model.ar is rewritten to the mapped destination id, texture-coordinate face indices are copied from the original face vertex indices, and per-face texture metadata is assigned.
R209 ModelRecoloringOverlay reads this transform's source-id set and mapping tables and labels affected model ids with exact '(texture)' and '(texturized)' diagnostics.

evidence.detail: The class composes optional recolor, retexture and reshade transforms plus one optional opacity scalar, then applies them in one deterministic pass to a Model.
NpcDefinition, ItemDefinition and SpotAnimationDefinition each store this exact type and apply it to constructed Models; config loaders lazily create it when surface-transform keys are encountered.
The item-config key opacity sets the composite scalar; application allocates Model.aq when needed and fills each face entry with 100 minus the configured opacity value.
The copy constructor clones the references/settings from another ModelSurfaceTransform, and definition cloning preserves this transform object explicitly.

evidence.detail: NpcDefinition, ItemDefinition and SpotAnimationDefinition config loaders map exact keys recolor/recolors to rs/a/b/a.
The transform owns source face/color-id sets plus per-source destination sequences and rewrites Model.ar entries only when the current face/color id belongs to a configured source group.
Each configured recolor group owns a cyclic destination int[] cursor, allowing repeated matching source ids to rotate through configured destination color ids.
R209 ModelRecoloringOverlay reads the transform's configured source-id set directly while presenting exact item/NPC/object recoloring diagnostics.

For every non-excluded face the per-face transform overwrites Model.ar[face] with the single constructor-supplied integer.
The class is installed only through ModelSurfaceTransform and is applied alongside recolor/retexture/opacity configuration to definition-built Models.
